name: Bogey Identification and Defusion
stage: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith
scenario: A client fiercely resists standard bi-weekly status updates, claiming they impose severe management overhead.
script: "It seems like this bi-weekly reporting cadence is an unacceptable operational burden for your team. If it is truly an existential issue, we will drop the requirement entirely, provided you agree to our net-30 payment terms."
defense: Name the bogey: removing a meeting does not offset accelerated net-30 terms; evaluate those terms on their own merits.
originFull: Deceptive Bargaining and Asymmetric Preference Exploitation involve pretending an issue of minor importance is a critical deal-breaker, only to trade it away later for major concessions.
defenseFull: Calling an unmasked bogey: "We appreciate the adjustment, but removing an unnecessary meeting does not offset the economic impact of accelerated net-30 terms. Let us evaluate net-30 terms on their standalone merits."
